messages:
troy_sales: Quick sync NimbleHealth wants a 12-week POC with a staged commit: $50k initial, $200k if they convert. They asked for a 20% ramp discount in months 2-6. Need deal desk path + faster approvals (they're on a tight procurement window).

lina_dealdesk: Can you paste the exact commercial ask? We need fields to route properly. Also, what's the requested turnaround SLA from procurement?

troy_sales: Request: initial commit $50,000, convertible to $250,000 total over 12 months if they hit usage thresholds. Discount schedule: month1 = 0% (trial), months2-6 = 20% off list for committed usage, months7-12 = 10% off if they convert. Procurement asked for a 4 business hour review on any special pricing.

oscar_revops: 4 business hours is aggressive. Our standard is 24h for deal desk. If procurement requires 4h we need an exec fast-path. We should capture these CPQ fields:
```
rw_special_discount_type = "ramp_rate"
rw_commit_value_usd = 250000
rw_poc_initial_commit_usd = 50000
rw_discount_schedule = "m2-6:20%, m7-12:10%"
rw_required_approval_sla = "4h_business"
rw_escalation_contact = "lina_dealdesk"
```
Also tag the opportunity with `POC-NIMBLE` and `FAST-SLA`.

lina_dealdesk: That looks good. We'll map the approval route: if rw_required_approval_sla == "4h_business" -> route to queue `dealdesk_fast_path`, notify `head_of_revenue` and `svpe`. Otherwise default to `dealdesk_standard`.

priya_engineering: Heads-up: providing staging tokens to Nimble requires a temporary network ACL entry. CS/legal will need to sign an NDA addendum. From CPQ side no blockers for fields; just ensure `rw_discount_schedule` is a single-line value or we won't parse it in automations.

legalbot: Automated reminder: any convertible commit with staged discounts requires legal review for conversion language and termination rights. Please upload draft terms to /contracts/drafts. Missing field detected: rw_escalation_contact.

oscar_revops: Noted. Lina, can you add a free-text `rw_special_terms_summary` field so legal gets the one-line summary? That helps speed review.

lina_dealdesk: Will do. Also creating a workflow snippet for CPQ automation: 
```yaml
- when: rw_required_approval_sla == "4h_business"
  route_to: dealdesk_fast_path
  notify: [lina_dealdesk, head_of_revenue, svpe]
  sla: 4h
- when: rw_commit_value_usd >= 200000
  escalate_to: head_of_revenue
  require_exec_signoff: true
```
I'll add that snippet to the workflow library.

troy_sales: Great. Oscar, Priya can you confirm staging & NDA path so I can tell Nimble procurement?

oscar_revops: I'll coordinate NDA template. Priya, can we provide temporary staging access until legal signs?

priya_engineering: We can provide limited staging tokens and IP allowlist for up to 7 days pending NDA. We need the `rw_poc_initial_commit_usd` field set on the quote to enable access provisioning.

legalbot: New quote event: created by troy_sales. Status: draft. Required fields missing: rw_special_terms_summary.

oscar_revops: I'll draft a one-line special terms summary and post it here shortly.

lina_dealdesk: ETA for CPQ field rollout: today EOD. I'll test the fast-path automation with a dummy opp once fields are live.

troy_sales: Thanks team I'll push the opportunity and follow up with Nimble procurement timeline. Will update this thread when legal confirms NDA language. :pray:
